01 / The message

Copywriting / Strategy

What information does this page actually provide?

Search-optimised content needs to be useful first. Search intent, clarity and accuracy belong together. We distinguish overviews, detailed questions and decision support, then develop the right headings, examples and links.

Relevance comes from usefulness.
02 / What words need to do

Content follows the question, not a word count.

Copy gives direction, answers specific questions and links meaningfully to more detailed content.

  1. 01Search intent before word count
  2. 02Verifiable statements
  3. 03Connect related content meaningfully
03 / The editorial process

Recognise questions.
Write useful answers.

We separate search needs from advertising messages and write for understanding rather than keyword density.

  1. 01

    Identify the need

    Distinguish common questions and the page types that answer them.

  2. 02

    Structure the copy

    Put important answers early and develop the details logically.

  3. 03

    Maintain quality

    Review content for accuracy and clarity rather than only measuring keyword density.

04 / Recognising quality

Content that genuinely answers a search question.

Strong, focused content with a clear role within the whole website.
